idea-plugin.name: Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Chat with Claude from inside Rider.
  • Tool window with conversation history
  • Send the current file or selection as context
  • Cursor position and file path are auto-attached
  • Model and API key configured in Settings → Tools → Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.12.0

  • "+" menu Browse files... now opens IntelliJ's file chooser and accepts any file type (the previous Swing JFileChooser was sometimes filtering to images on some platforms). Text files are attached as-is; binary non-image files are rejected with a chat warning.
  • New "+" menu entry: "Image from clipboard" - appears when an image is on the system clipboard, so you can paste a screenshot without focusing the input.
  • Remove (X) buttons on pending attachments are now icon-only, borderless, 16x16 - much less visual weight.
  • Action-row buttons (attach toggles, Plan, +, hamburger) use a flat / borderless style, matching JetBrains AI Assistant's inline controls. Toggles still fill blue when armed.

0.11.0

  • Bottom controls consolidated into a single tight row: + dropdown, Current file toggle, Selection toggle on the left; Plan toggle + hamburger on the right. Smaller font and tighter margins make the row noticeably more compact.
  • "Agent" toggle replaced with "Plan" toggle (inverse semantics). Default off, meaning agent mode is on - Claude can read/edit files with the usual per-write confirmation. Toggle Plan on for read-only conversations.

0.10.0

  • Chat input redesign. Text input is now at the top. Below it: pending thumbnails / file chips, then a row of small inline attach toggles ("Current file", "Selection"), then a row with a new "+" dropdown (Browse files... + the currently-open editor files), the "Agent" toggle (default on), and the hamburger menu on the far right.
  • Agent toggle is a first-class top-level button now (blue when armed) instead of a hidden checkbox in the menu.
  • The "+" dropdown's "Open editor files" section reads from FileEditorManager - one click attaches a file you already have open.

0.9.2

  • Build fix: 'return@try' isn't valid Kotlin (try blocks aren't labeled scopes). Restructured tryExtractContent to wrap the body in try/catch with regular function-level returns.

0.9.1

  • Build fix: 0.9.0 didn't compile (protected Clipboard.contents access + a chained ?.let { return@try ... } that the Kotlin parser couldn't make sense of). Same feature set, now actually buildable.

0.9.0

  • Attach arbitrary files to a message: via the hamburger menu's Attach files... entry, by drag-dropping onto the input box, or by Ctrl+V from the system clipboard.
  • Pending file attachments now appear alongside image thumbnails above the input, each with a small X
